# UI Specification v2 — VocalSat

**Framework:** WebView2 (HTML/CSS/JS)
**Contract:** `Design/v2-ui-map.json` (source of truth — the preview is composed from it)
**Preview:** `Design/v2-test.html` (generated by `node bin/apc.js ui-compose VocalSat --map v2-ui-map.json`)

## What changed from v1

- **Fixed knob overlap.** Knob cells were 6 x 8.5; the catalog dial (`flex:1; aspect-ratio:1`)
  grew to ~7.6 rem wide and invaded the neighboring knob. Cells are now **6 x 6.5**,
  so the dial stays inside its column.
- **Fixed meter label collision.** Removed the `VU METER` label that sat on top of the
  `METER` section tag.
- **Fixed meter aspect.** The VU canvas was 20 x 17.5 (too tall for the painter). It is now
  **20 x 10.5**, so the dial fills the well instead of shrinking into the bottom corner.
- **Meter contrast.** Added `--meter-ink` / `--meter-accent` / `--meter-brand` so the VU face
  uses dark ink on cream while the rest of the UI keeps ivory text on dark metal.
- **Meter scale spacing.** The painter used to number every dB from -3 to +3, which stacked
  labels in the crowded top of the arc. Numbered marks are now only
  **-20, -10, -7, -3, 0, +3**; minor ticks stay unlabeled.
- **Needle clearance.** The preview needle is shorter than the label ring and rests between
  `-3` and `0`, so it no longer crosses a number or the `CHANNEL VOCAL` text.
- **Pivot clipping.** Pivot moved from 0.97 to 0.90 of canvas height so the pivot cap is
  fully drawn inside the well.
- **Balanced left column.** Added a `CHARACTER` panel under the meter with two notes.

## Layout

- **Window:** 720 x 480 px base
- **Plate:** 45 x 30 grid cells (1 rem = 1 cell, 16 px at 1x)
- **Mode:** `scalable` — uniform scale, aspect ratio locked
- **Scale range:** 0.5x to 3.0x
- **Edge policy:** `letterbox` (fill token `--surface`)
- **Resize handle:** in-page corner gripper (bottom-right)
- **Presets:** 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0

### Sections

| Section | Cell (x,y,w,h) | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `mast` | 0.5, 0.5, 44, 3.25 | Brand and tagline |
| `meter-bay` | 1.5, 4, 22.5, 13.5 | VU meter |
| `notes` | 1.5, 18, 22.5, 6 | Character notes |
| `controls` | 24.75, 4, 19.75, 20 | Drive / Tone / Mix + readouts + bypass |
| `footer` | 0.5, 25.75, 44, 3.75 | Oversampling and format notes |

### Grid structure

- Top mast spans the full width.
- Left column: meter bay (top) + character notes (bottom).
- Right column: saturation controls, top-aligned with the meter bay.
- Three equal knob columns at x = 25.5, 32, 38.5 (6 cells wide, 6.5 tall).
- Value readouts directly under each knob (y = 13.5).
- Bypass switch under the readout row (y = 18).
- Footer spans the full width.

## Controls

| Parameter | Type | Position (x,y,w,h) | Range | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `drive` | Rotary knob | 25.5, 6, 6, 6.5 | 0.0 - 24.0 dB | 6.0 dB |
| `tone` | Rotary knob | 32, 6, 6, 6.5 | -100.0 - 100.0 % | 0 % |
| `mix` | Rotary knob | 38.5, 6, 6, 6.5 | 0.0 - 100.0 % | 100 % |
| `drive-readout` | LED screen | 25.5, 13.5, 6, 2.25 | — | "6.0 dB" |
| `tone-readout` | LED screen | 32, 13.5, 6, 2.25 | — | "0 %" |
| `mix-readout` | LED screen | 38.5, 13.5, 6, 2.25 | — | "100 %" |
| `bypass` | Panel switch | 25.5, 18, 9, 3 | on/off | off |

**Non-interactive elements:** `brand`, `tagline`, `note-1`, `note-2`, `footer-left`,
`footer-right`, and the `meter` canvas (VU).

## Typography

- UI font: `"Bahnschrift", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif`
- Labels: 0.625 rem, 600 weight, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em
- Readouts: 0.8125 rem, tabular numerals
- Micro text (footer): 0.4375 rem

## Style Notes

- **Vintage studio outboard:** warm dark metal, ivory silk-screen text, amber backlight.
- The VU meter is the visual anchor on the left; the three knobs are the interaction focus on the right.
- Visual character comes from the token palette plus the built-in `vu-meter` canvas painter;
  no hand-authored CSS is allowed on the plate.
- Layout must remain legible down to 0.5x: labels use the catalog's legibility floors (`max(9px, …)`).
- **Knob cells must stay square-ish** (height ≤ width + ~0.85 rem) or the aspect-ratio dial
  overflows into the neighboring column.

## Implementation Notes (for `/apc-impl`)

- Control DOM ids are emitted as `id="ctl-<id>"` with `data-param="<param>"`.
- Only `drive`, `tone`, `mix` are automatable; `bypass` is a UI switch (not in the v1 parameter spec).
- The VU meter canvas is a visual placeholder in the design preview (it uses the kit's built-in
  painter with a `VU` face via `--meter-brand`); production metering uses live peak/RMS atomics.
- Do not invent elements outside this map — `apc validate ui` enforces DOM ↔ manifest parity.
